source.title: Penal Code Act, Chapter 532, Laws of the Federal Capital Territory, Abuja
source.extracted_from: Own Arrangement of Sections, PDF pages 1-23; Chapter XXII from the body heading, PDF page 135
source.note: The only copy found omits sections 197 to 212, 364 and 365, and refers sections 410 to 477 to the Penal Code (Northern States) Federal Provisions Act, so those numbers are left out. Chapters XIV and XV fall wholly inside the gap. Provisions sit under ".code" because the first import was materialised with uncorrected text, which cannot be replaced.
